finding.title: OS Command Injection via Filename
finding.trigger: An attacker can inject a malicious filename that includes shell metacharacters or special sequences.
finding.assumptions: The filename parameter is derived from untrusted input. The environment where this code runs supports shell interpretation for file paths.

finding.title: OS Command Injection via File Path
finding.sink: output << '[' << file << ':' << line << '] ' << '[' << function << '] ' << logLevelToString(level) << ': ' << message << std::endl;
finding.trigger: An attacker can inject a malicious file path or function name that includes shell metacharacters or special sequences.
finding.assumptions: The file, line, and function parameters are derived from untrusted input. The environment where this code runs supports shell interpretation for file paths.
